newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Mystery kangaroo prompts new Swedish tourism.
newsitem.headline: Mystery kangaroo prompts new Swedish tourism.

text.p: Reports of a kangaroo spotted in a central Swedish forest has prompted a new tourist industry usually confined to Australia -- kangaroo T-shirts, jewellery, and even cakes.

Tourist spokeswoman for Hagfors in Varmland, Renate Heidkamp, said on Tuesday a kangaroo craze had hit the region in central Sweden after several reported but unconfirmed sightings of a kangaroo this year.
However with no Swedish zoos reporting any missing marsupials, some scepticism has crept in.
A leading veterinarian said that if the animal was a kangaroo it would only be able to survive until the snow arrives and temperatures plummet below zero in November.
